description: This file defines the interface ISiloLifecycle within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, representing the observable lifecycle of a silo including stages indicating when it has started and stopped.

methods.name: HighestCompletedStage
methods.description: An integer property indicating the highest stage that has completed starting.

methods.name: LowestStoppedStage
methods.description: An integer property indicating the lowest stage that has completed stopping.
